analyzed_vuln.description: Use-after-free of attribute name strings: xmlTextReaderFreeProp() frees cur->name (DICT_FREE) when streaming reader prunes old nodes, but DTD validation still holds xmlRef entries pointing to the same xmlAttr (or its name). Later xmlValidateDocumentFinal()->xmlValidateRef() reports unknown IDREF and passes attr->name to xmlErrValidNode, causing read of freed memory during formatted error printing (__xmlRaiseError). Crash manifests in valid.c, but root cause is premature attribute/property reclamation in xmlreader.c while refs table still references them.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered in xml fuzz harness using xmlTextReaderRead incremental parsing with DTD validation/IDREF tracking enabled by input DOCTYPE/ATTLIST. Input must create IDREF/IDREFS attribute entries in doc->refs and then let xmlTextReaderRead cleanup path free prior element attributes (xmlTextReaderFreeNode -> xmlTextReaderFreePropList -> xmlTextReaderFreeProp) before end-of-document validation runs. At end document, xmlValidateDocumentFinal scans doc->refs and dereferences stale attr/name pointer, leading to UAF.
